The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed two–stage approach can be successfully applied to counter–attack adversarial attacks against the Google toxicity model, thus providing a way of restoring toxicity scores of comments that are obfuscated by adversarial attacks.

, even though novel adversary challenges will keep coming up, we believe that techniques combining machine-learning–based models and text pattern recognition would be needed to robustly detect toxic language, thus enabling a harassment–free digital interaction.
